title: Order Granting Extension (Docket No. 23-2643-01)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH - 

Application of Mountain Green Mutual 
Water Company for Exemption 

DOCKET NO. 23-2643-01 

ORDER GRANTING EXTENSION 

ISSUED: August 27, 2024 

On April 22, 2024, the Public Service Commission (PSC) issued a scheduling 
order establishing deadlines in this docket, including that non-applicant written direct 
testimony was due on Monday, August 26, 2024. On August 26, 2024, after close of 
business, the Division of Public Utilities (DPU) filed a request for an extension 
requesting that the deadline for its written direct testimony be extended to September 
5, 2024, and representing the extension is necessary “[d]ue to an unforeseen medical 
emergency of a key staff member[.]” (the “DPU Request”). 

Good cause supports the DPU Request, and it is therefore granted. DPU shall 
have until Thursday, September 5, 2024, to file its written direct testimony. If applicant 
Mountain Green Mutual Water Company or intervenor Highlands Water Co. believes 
the extension is unwarranted, either may file a request seeking to establish an earlier 
deadline explaining why its proposed earlier deadline is appropriate. 

DOCKET NO. 23-2643-01
